title: 全能视频
purpose: One API entrypoint for txt2video, img2video, first-frame video, b-roll, transition, talking head and product demo video jobs.

required_inputs.task_type: txt2video | img2video | first_frame | broll | transition | talking_head | product_demo
required_inputs.reference_image: optional first frame or identity/product reference
required_inputs.pose_video: optional pose/motion reference video for openpose_motion

recommended_branches.description: Reference image as first frame / I2V conditioning.
Reference image through IPAdapter/FaceID branch while video model still generates motion.
Product reference image through IPAdapter branch for product consistency.
Use pose_video or pose frame sequence, not a single still image, to control motion.

implementation_notes: Build this in ComfyUI first, then export API JSON and map real node IDs in the management UI.
Keep output video-only. Do not include generated audio; TTS/FFmpeg handle voice, subtitles and final mix.
Do not use one still image as the OpenPose control for an entire clip. Use pose_video or a pose frame sequence for openpose_motion.
If the video model cannot accept IPAdapter directly, keep IPAdapter in an upstream keyframe/identity branch and feed its result to I2V.
